description: South Korea other-income (gita sodeuk) withholding of 22% on income after deemed expenses, e.g. lecture fees, manuscript fees and prizes, with the KRW 50,000 exemption threshold.

expenseRate.description: Deemed expense rate: 0.6 (lectures, manuscripts, advisory), 0.8 (public-interest prizes) or 0; default 0.6
